meta.name: CodeQuest
meta.description: Bundled starter content used when no remote pack is published or the published pack is invalid.
meta.author: CodeQuest
changelog: Content packs can now be edited, published, versioned, and rolled back from /admin.
New lessons download in the background and apply after the current lesson ends.

copy.dashboardSubtitle: Build a lesson from your own code, a PDF handout, or a GitHub repo. Every solution is executed before you ever see it — anything that fails its tests is thrown away.
copy.emptyStateBody: Paste a bug you are stuck on, upload a handout, or name a goal. CodeQuest writes the exercises and proves each solution in the sandbox.
copy.loginSubtitle: Sessions are per-email so quotas, streaks, and your lesson library stay yours.
copy.newLessonTitle: What are you trying to learn?
copy.newLessonSubtitle: CodeQuest writes a short lesson from your source material, then executes every reference solution in the sandbox. Solutions that fail are discarded before the lesson is saved.
copy.footer: Every solution is executed in a sandbox before it reaches you · Tagalog & Bisaya translations · streak emails
